project.name: Daher End Maternity Admission
project.description: Narrow, Daher-owned OpenMRS clinical-operations module (ADR-030/ADR-040). Exposes only two operations: end the active canonical Daher Maternity Admission Visit and create a new server-numbered TestOrder bound to its Admission encounter. Never grants a Daher clinical role Edit Visits, Assign Beds, Edit Admission Locations, Manage Queue Entries, Get Global Properties, Get Orders, or generic order-read/configuration authority; external configuration HTTP resources are separately restricted to Daher sys-admin. See DECISIONS.md ADR-030 and PROJECT_STATE.md BLOCKER-10 for the full design record.
